name: sap-ariba
label: SAP Ariba
description: Automate procurement, contracts, and invoices with SAP Ariba.

apiKey.label: Application Key (APIKey)
apiKey.description: The Application Key for your application.

host.label: API Host
host.description: The host of the API runtime URL, such as openapi.ariba.com.

api.label: API Name
api.description: The API in the runtime URL, such as purchase-orders-buyer in https://openapi.ariba.com/api/purchase-orders-buyer/v1/prod. A credential reaches one API, so the actions of each group need a credential for their own API.

version.label: API Version
version.description: The version in the runtime URL, such as v1.

environment.label: Environment
environment.description: The environment in the runtime URL, such as prod or sandbox.

list_purchase_orders.label: List Purchase Orders
list_purchase_orders.description: Retrieves purchase order header information for a specified buyer.

buyerANID.label: Buyer ANID
buyerANID.description: The buyer's Ariba Network ID, sent as X-ARIBA-NETWORK-ID.

supplierANID.label: Supplier ANID
supplierANID.description: Filter by supplier's Ariba Network ID.

documentNumber.label: Document Number
documentNumber.description: Filter by order ID / purchase order number.

startDate.label: Start Date
startDate.description: Filter orders received on or after this date. Max range: 31 days.

endDate.label: End Date
endDate.description: Filter orders received on or before this date. Max range: 31 days.

list_purchase_order_items.label: List Purchase Order Line Items
list_purchase_order_items.description: Retrieves line item information from purchase orders for a specified buyer.

buyerANID.label: Buyer ANID
buyerANID.description: The buyer's Ariba Network ID, sent as X-ARIBA-NETWORK-ID.

documentNumber.label: Document Number
documentNumber.description: Filter by order ID / purchase order number.

startDate.label: Start Date
startDate.description: Filter orders received on or after this date. Max range: 31 days.

endDate.label: End Date
endDate.description: Filter orders received on or before this date. Max range: 31 days.

get_document_changes.label: Get Document Changes
get_document_changes.description: Returns the list of changes to approvable documents.

realm.label: Realm
realm.description: The name of the SAP Ariba realm (site), such as testrealm.

changeSequenceId.label: Change Sequence ID
changeSequenceId.description: Only return changes after this sequence ID. Leave empty to get all changes.

top.label: Page Size
top.description: Number of records to return (max 1000, default 10).

get_pending_approvables.label: Get Pending Approvables
get_pending_approvables.description: List all documents/tasks that are pending approval.

realm.label: Realm
realm.description: The name of the SAP Ariba realm (site), such as testrealm.

top.label: Page Size
top.description: Number of records to return (max 100, default 100).

get_catalog_items.label: Get Catalog Items
get_catalog_items.description: Get list of filtered catalog items for a specific supplier.

realm.label: Realm
realm.description: The name of the SAP Ariba realm (site), such as testrealm.

supplierId.label: Supplier ID
supplierId.description: The supplier's domain and ID, such as buyersystemid:Supplier16.

select.label: Select Fields
select.description: Output fields to return, comma-separated (e.g., SupplierPartId,SupplierId,LeadTime).

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 1000).

get_active_catalogs.label: Get Active Catalogs
get_active_catalogs.description: Get list of active catalog data and supplier values from the specified date.

realm.label: Realm
realm.description: The name of the SAP Ariba realm (site), such as testrealm.

date.label: Activated From Date
date.description: Get catalogs activated from this date (ISO format).

supplierdomain.label: Supplier Domain
supplierdomain.description: Filter by the supplier's domain and ID, such as buyersystemid:Supplier16.

get_facet_data.label: Get Facet Data
get_facet_data.description: Get list of facet data for a realm.

realm.label: Realm
realm.description: The name of the SAP Ariba realm (site), such as testrealm.

list_invoices.label: List Invoices
list_invoices.description: Retrieves header information of one or more invoices in Ariba Network.

anId.label: Ariba Network ID
anId.description: The buyer's or supplier's Ariba Network ID (ANID), sent as X-ARIBA-NETWORK-ID.

includeInvoiceProfile.label: Include Invoice Profile
includeInvoiceProfile.description: Display Invoice Profile related fields (e.g., Address, Tax Id).

search_contract_workspaces.label: Search Contract Workspaces
search_contract_workspaces.description: Search contract workspaces based on attributes such as title, contract ID, region, etc.

realm.label: Realm
realm.description: The name of the SAP Ariba realm (site), such as testrealm.

user.label: User
user.description: User ID to perform the action on behalf of.

passwordAdapter.label: Password Adapter
passwordAdapter.description: Password adapter to authenticate the user.

select.label: Select Fields
select.description: Comma-separated metadata fields to retrieve (e.g., title,contractid,region).

top.label: Page Size
top.description: Number of records to return (default 500, max 500).

count.label: Include Count
count.description: Include total number of records in response.

get_contract_workspace.description: Search for a contract workspace using a unique identifier.
